providerDefault: omitted on Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Opus 4.8 and 4.7; summarized on Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6 and earlier
summary: Whether the reasoning summary comes back in the response. summarized returns readable summary text in each thinking block; omitted returns the block with an empty thinking field. Thinking still happens and is billed identically either way, so this is purely about what you receive.
combines: The default flipped on the newer models, so a UI that renders reasoning has to ask for summarized explicitly or it will show nothing on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5.
omitted is faster to first visible token when streaming: the server skips streaming thinking tokens and sends only the signature.
Either way the block's signature still carries the encrypted reasoning, so multi-turn continuity is unaffected by this choice.
The raw chain of thought is never returned under any setting; summarized means a summary, not the reasoning verbatim.
note: It must be rendered as part of pipeline.
